Definition: a form (of beauty; as if pressed out, i.e. carved); hence, an (idolatrous) image
BiblicalUsage: In the Bible, tsîyr means a form, a carved image. In Psalms 49:14, their beauty shall consume in the grave from their dwelling, and it appears again in Isaiah 45:16.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe tsîyr still tells the truth about God, and I take it as it stands.
